name: Check DWI Orientation
summary: Reports the orientation (neurological or radiological) of a diffusion-weighted (DWI) NIfTI image with FSL fslorient; a quality-control utility that produces no new image data.
description: Runs fslorient on the diffusion-weighted (DWI) image and writes the reported orientation (NEUROLOGICAL or RADIOLOGICAL) to product.json, shown on brainlife.io. Use it to check data before processing that assumes a particular voxel orientation. It does not change or reorient the image.

inputs.description: diffusion-weighted (DWI) NIfTI image whose orientation is checked.

outputs.description: Placeholder output; the orientation result is reported in product.json rather than as files.
